quotes.name: Manjit Singh
quotes.quote: The first thing I did in my new place was unpack my grandmother's old tea set; my friends from the community helped me move. I decided to prioritize getting the water heater fixed over a weekend trip because I wanted to settle in comfortably.

quotes.name: Kris Bubic
quotes.quote: I moved to Lake Merritt because I wanted a change of scenery and a bit more space, and I'm taking the memories of my time in West Oakland with me, especially the community and the A's games.
